turns.content:
All 10 query tests pass in `memory-kernel`, and both `peek-cli` and `viewer-api` compile against the moved module.

Summary of the change:
- Moved `JqFilter`/`filter_values`/`transform_values` from [viewer-api/src/query.rs](viewer-api/src/query.rs) into a new [workflow-tools/memory-kernel/src/query.rs](workflow-tools/memory-kernel/src/query.rs), adding the `jaq-*` deps to [workflow-tools/memory-kernel/Cargo.toml](workflow-tools/memory-kernel/Cargo.toml) and registering the module in [workflow-tools/memory-kernel/src/lib.rs](workflow-tools/memory-kernel/src/lib.rs).
- [viewer-api/src/query.rs](viewer-api/src/query.rs) is now a thin `pub use memory_kernel::query::*;` re-export (source compat preserved for existing `viewer_api::query::JqFilter` callers), with [viewer-api/Cargo.toml](viewer-api/Cargo.toml) depending on `memory-kernel` instead of the `jaq-*` crates directly.
- Fixed the peek-cli compile error by depending on `memory-kernel` directly (not the server-only `viewer-api`) in [workflow-tools/peek/crates/peek-cli/Cargo.toml](workflow-tools/peek/crates/peek-cli/Cargo.toml) and updating the import in [workflow-tools/peek/crates/peek-cli/tests/repo_map_contracts.rs](workflow-tools/peek/crates/peek-cli/tests/repo_map_contracts.rs).

This matches the `kernel-layering` boundary (memory-kernel owns generic storage/indexing/search primitives) — I didn't touch other viewer-api-only features (HTTP/MCP server plumbing, auth, sse, etc.), since those are genuinely server-specific, but flagging as you suspected there may be more candidates worth a similar look if other non-server binaries end up needing them.
